Name: NPC Attack Slot
Description: Adds attack slots to an NPC's Attack_SM in its c9997.hkx, copied from a vanilla attack state (Attack3000 by default), each entered by both of its wildcards (W_Attack<ID> and W_Event<ID>), as every vanilla slot is.
Snippet:
function Attack{Id}_onActivate()
    CallActionState({Id})
end

function Attack{Id}_onUpdate()
    if AttackCommonFunction({Id}, STYLE_DEFAULT, TRUE) == TRUE then
        return
    end
end
Notes: Add the functions below to the NPC's c9997.hks, as vanilla has them for Attack3000-Attack3039.
c9997.hks only runs AI attacks with IDs from ANIME_ID_ATTACK_BEGIN to ANIME_ID_ATTACK_END (3000-3039 in vanilla): raise ANIME_ID_ATTACK_END to cover {Ids}.
Add the animations to the NPC's anibnd, with their time acts.
